deployment: in-process Ganache only, no public network
tests: uint256 integer-root boundary and 64 deterministic independent-oracle cases
outsider cannot issue, revoke, assign or exit
invalid member/guild and canonical no-duplicate membership
empty and all-zero guild have explicit no-authority policy
scope, zero amount/reference, nonce and replay rejected
denominator unaffected by caller omission or duplicate lists; exact normalized fractions
move, old-scope revocation, return and exit preserve canonical sums
deterministic mixed mutation sequence independently checks cache, scope and credit totals
trusted administrator can attest false work under distinct references (documented residual)
limitations: address uniqueness is not human uniqueness
